idea-plugin.name: CodeSprint
idea-plugin.description:
CodeSprint is a lightweight productivity companion for students and professional developers. It lives in a tool window and helps you build a consistent coding habit with a Pomodoro focus timer, daily goals, streak tracking and simple statistics. Works in Android Studio and every IntelliJ-based IDE.

Focus. Code. Improve.

Features

  • Focus timer: 25 minute focus sessions, 5 minute short breaks and 15 minute long breaks, all configurable. Start, pause, resume, reset and switch session type.
  • Accurate and reliable: the timer is calculated from timestamps, so it keeps counting while you switch files, close the tool window or restart the IDE. A session that finishes while the IDE is closed is credited the next time it opens.
  • Daily goal: pick a target with presets (30m, 1h, 2h, 3h) or a custom value and track your progress.
  • Statistics: today's focus time, completed sessions, weekly focus time, goal completion, current streak and longest streak.
  • Weekly overview: a seven day chart of completed focus time.
  • Motivational reminders: more than 30 professional developer quotes shown at an interval you choose, in the status bar, as a notification, or on demand.
  • Status bar timer: always-visible countdown; click to start, pause or resume.
  • Native look and feel: follows the IDE theme (light, dark, high contrast) and scales with the IDE.

Privacy

Everything is stored locally in the IDE configuration folder. CodeSprint has no account, no backend and no telemetry, makes no network requests, and never reads your source code.

Getting started

  1. Open the CodeSprint tool window from the right sidebar, or use Tools | CodeSprint.
  2. Press Start to begin a focus session.
  3. Change durations, goals and reminders in Settings | Tools | CodeSprint.
